capabilities: Follow the active note's outgoing links as an ordered outline
Display a one-hop focused graph of the current note
Keep graph positions and navigation history session-only without editing notes
disambiguation: Not a vault-wide graph view; it only reads the active note's direct outgoing links and does not infer backlinks.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; a demo vault, user guide, and roadmap are hosted outside the README.
problem: Obsidian's graph view is vault-wide and unordered, so it doesn't show the direct outgoing links of the current note in their written order.
